movie.name: Dune: Part Three
movie.description: Twelve years after the events of the previous chapter, Paul Atreides rules as Emperor of the known universe but faces mounting rebellion from rival Houses and internal betrayal. Worshipped by the Fremen and feared by his enemies, he must confront the cost of power and the consequences of his choices. As alliances shift and a new generation emerges, Paul’s reign is tested in ways he never imagined.

cast_info.cast_bio: Timothée Hal Chalamet is an American actor. He has received various accolades, including nominations for an Academy Award, two Golden Globe Awards, and three BAFTA Film Awards. Chalamet began his career as a teenager in television productions, appearing in the drama series Homeland in 2012

Zendaya is an American actress and  singer who started her career as a child model and backup dancer in music videos. She gained prominence with her role as Rocky Blue on Disney Channel’s popular sitcom Shake it Up and also after participating in the reality dance show/competition Dancing With the Stars. She has starred in movies like The Greatest Showman and Spider-Man: Homecoming. A graduate of the Oakland School for the Arts, Zendaya, she has modeled for stores like Macy’s, Old Navy and Mervyn's. She was also a part of the California Shakespeare Theater and studied at the CalShakes Conservatory Program and at the American Conservatory Theater. Her debut album as a singer put her on number 51 on the Billboard 200 chart in 2013.

Rebecca Ferguson is a Swedish actress who grew to prominence with her portrayal of an  upper-class girl Anna Gripenhielm in the soap-opera Nya tider. Her first breakthrough role in a  film was opposite Tom Cruise in Mission Impossible: Rogue Nation for which she also won an award. Her other popular films include Despite the Falling Snow and The Girl on the Train. Prior to her acting career, Ferguson worked as a model and was also a dancer, enjoying expertise in several dance forms like jazz, tango and ballet.

Started his carrier as Cedric Diggory in the movie Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire, Robert Pattison has become a heartthrob since then. The actor got much fame from movie Twilight in which he did the lead role of Edward Cullen which gave him his girl fan base from all around the world. Times newspaper even gave him the title of ‘British Star of Tomorrow’. Pattinson has been starred in many movies and has done incredible roles, some of them are The Rover(2014), Water for Elephants(2011), Good Times(2017), Remember Me(2010), Cosmopolis(2012), The King(2019), Damsel(2018) and many more.

Rose to fame from Lady Macbeth, Florence Paul is a successful actress. From the city of Oxfordshire to Hollywood her journey has been incredible. She has worked in so many amazing ventures which include Fighting with My Family (2019), The Falling (2014), Midsommar (2019), and Outlaw King (2018). The next movie in which Florence Pugh will be seen is Black Widow.

Jason Momoa is an American model, writer, filmmaker and actor. He rose to fame with the roles of Ronon Dex in the sci-fi series Stargate Atlantis and Khal Drogo in the fantasy series Game of Thrones. His popularity further grew with the recurring role of Arthur Curry/Aquaman in the DC Extended Universe. Momoa has won several accolades for his performances.

Anya Taylor Joy is an actress best known for her roles in films like The Witch, Split and Thoroughbreds. Her recurring appearances in horror films earned her the title of scream-queen over the years. She also won several awards and nominations for her performances.

Javier Ángel Encinas Bardem is a Spanish actor. Known for his roles in blockbusters and foreign films, he has received various accolades, including an Academy Award, a British Academy Film Award, and a Golden Globe Award.
